description: This file defines a FileSystem class providing an interface for filesystem operations such as path manipulations, file reading/writing, directory management, and utility functions, intended for use within the webkitpy project.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: A class providing an interface for various filesystem operations, including path manipulations, file reading/writing, directory management, and utility functions, designed for use within the webkitpy project.

methods.name: abspath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the given path.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonical path of the given path.

methods.name: path_to_module
methods.description: Returns the file path of a given module, facilitating unit testing.

methods.name: expanduser
methods.description: Expands the ~ in a path to the user home directory.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Returns the base name of a path.

methods.name: chdir
methods.description: Changes the current working directory.

methods.name: copyfile
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory component of a path.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists.

methods.name: files_under
methods.description: Recursively lists all files under a directory, with options to skip directories and filter files.

methods.name: getcwd
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: glob
methods.description: Returns a list of paths matching a pattern.

methods.name: isabs
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute.

methods.name: isfile
methods.description: Checks if a path is a file.

methods.name: isdir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins path components.

methods.name: listdir
methods.description: Lists entries in a directory.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Generates file names in a directory tree.

methods.name: mkdtemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory that can be used as a context manager.

methods.name: maybe_make_directory
methods.description: Creates a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a file or directory.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a file.

methods.name: normpath
methods.description: Normalizes a path.

methods.name: open_binary_tempfile
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary binary file, returning the file object and filename.

methods.name: open_binary_file_for_reading
methods.description: Opens a file for binary reading.

methods.name: read_binary_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a binary file.

methods.name: write_binary_file
methods.description: Writes binary data to a file.

methods.name: open_text_file_for_reading
methods.description: Opens a text file for reading with UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: open_text_file_for_writing
methods.description: Opens a text file for writing with UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: read_text_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a UTF-8 encoded text file.

methods.name: write_text_file
methods.description: Writes UTF-8 encoded text to a file.

methods.name: sha1
methods.description: Computes the SHA-1 hash of a file's contents.

methods.name: relpath
methods.description: Returns the relative path from a start directory.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a file, with retries on Windows to handle file locks.

methods.name: rmtree
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory tree.

methods.name: copytree
methods.description: Recursively copies a directory tree.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename.

methods.name: splitext
methods.description: Splits a filename into name and extension.

methods.name: make_executable
methods.description: Sets executable permissions on a file.
